data.pixel_selection: native ivar>0; finite f/err/wdisp; f!=0; wdisp>0; frozen low-error filters; no extra OR-mask veto

nonparametric.definition: Cumulative W50=v75-v25; W20=v60-v40; FW20peak is20%-peak full width. Intrinsic shape is nonnegative piecewise-linear, forward-convolved with assumed Gaussian LSF.
nonparametric.subtraction: Selected parametric continuum+narrow+nuisance removed; fitted absorption added back. Both assumptions propagate as systematics, not in conditional noise interval.
nonparametric.moment_window: -5000 to+5000 km/s; all moments and quantiles truncated to this window
nonparametric.ve_definition: Common exponential log-slope on both recovered wings, separate intercepts, |v-vpeak| from max(FWHM/2,300) to4000km/s; only bins>3conditional-noise. Null if insufficient bins or non-decreasing wings.
nonparametric.noise_scope: Independent Gaussian pixel noise; fixed selected regularization, narrow/continuum and absorption. Does not include extraction covariance or their parameter errors.
